obligations.source_text: old-growth forest structure is the primary subject, visibly expressed through multiple living-tree cohorts, vertically layered canopy, standing snag, and fallen nurse log

bindings.live_tree_cohorts_phrase: large live trees and smaller cohorts show visibly different trunk diameters and heights
bindings.canopy_layers_phrase: overstory midstory and understory foliage remain separately readable at multiple depths
bindings.standing_snag_phrase: at least one standing dead snag is structurally distinct from the live trunks
bindings.fallen_log_phrase: one or more large fallen logs lie on the forest floor with convincing scale and contact
